review_areas: Feature-author ergonomics against the v2 and opaque branches
CLI, configuration, artifact handling, and verification

resolved_findings.finding: Box payload properties could incorrectly make the owning Box Copy.
resolved_findings.resolution: Box always clears Copy; isolated inherited bug fix with regression.

resolved_findings.finding: Borrowing a map incorrectly made floating-point values Eq.
resolved_findings.resolution: Borrowed-map equality follows value properties; conservative owned-map policy retained.

resolved_findings.finding: A finalized enum could reach known unsupported-renderer panic paths.
resolved_findings.resolution: Finalization reports unsupported response/object enum usage and lifetime combinations.

resolved_findings.finding: Final union tags still read original component discriminators after representation changes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Classification accepts an explicit tag provider and uses canonical represented structs; semantic Components remains separate.

resolved_findings.finding: Fixture imports used inference-side names rather than canonical declaration names.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use canonical names and validate public addressability, preserving guaranteed legacy facade path spellings.

resolved_findings.finding: Alternate item placement required mutating a default layout and remembering validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Expose a validated from_placements constructor and reuse it for default placement and relocation tests.

resolved_findings.finding: Request collection repeated a duplicate check guaranteed by unique source keys.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use a fallible collect and retain lowering errors.

resolved_findings.finding: A rejected duplicate artifact write replaced the original bytes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reject through BTreeMap::entry before replacement; materialization regression confirms original content.

resolved_findings.finding: Documentation mapping had only a working-directory-dependent constructor.
resolved_findings.resolution: Add an empty Default and explicit-path load; CLI new() still reads doc_urls.json.

scope_notes: The Box/borrowed-map corrections fix inherited trait-analysis bugs and are a separate commit from neutral construction changes.
Unsupported enum checks produce early errors; arbitrary response enum semantics are not added.
Default fixture path spellings are preserved instead of switching every reference to physical model crate paths.
No general placement/feature policy framework, crate-handle branding, or configuration naming normalization is introduced.
input_provenance: Same pinned v2494 spec, fixtures, library version, Rust 1.89.0, and nightly formatter recorded in neutral_refactor_validation.json.
